x: For the Youths, keep in touch with Les Stokell and Tom Carter, they will know all about the fixtures and will advise you of events in which to take part.

Under the guidance of Tom Carter and Les Stokell the lads have made tremendous strides during the winter months. Regular Tuesday evening and Saturday afternoon pack training from the Hall with Tom has brought a tremendous team spirit, and with it an improvement in performance.

Our other men to finish, with nine to compete and six to score, were Les Stokell 64th, Albert Frost 95th, and finally Dick Tobin 132nd.
